title: GKIDS Releases 100 Meters Anime Film on Blu-ray Disc on December 1
content:
GKIDS announced on Wednesday that it will release the anime film of Uoto 's 100 Meters ( Hyakuemu ) manga on Blu-ray Disc on December 1.

The Collector's Edition includes five art cards and a mini-poster. The disc release includes an interview with director Kenji Iwaisawa , a rotoscoping workshop, and scene breakdowns. Pre-orders are open exclusively on GKIDS ' online store.

The movie premiered in Japan in September 2025. The film ranked #8 in its opening weekend, and earned 102,666,040 yen (about US$694,700) in its first three days.

GKIDS screened the film in October 2025 in Japanese with English subtitles and with an English dub . The film also screened in Los Angeles that October.

The film held its world premiere at Annecy in June 2025. The Japan Society screened the East Coast premiere in New York that October with director Kenji Iwaisawa in attendance. The film won the runner-up award for Best Animated Film at the Florida Film Critics Circle Awards in 2025.

Tori Matsuzaka plays the gifted runner Togashi, while Shōta Sometani plays Komiya, a hard worker whose obsession with the 100-meter dash began when he met Togashi.

Kenji Iwaisawa ( ON-GAKU: Our Sound ) directed the film at Rock 'n' Roll Mountain . Pony Canyon , TBS TV, and ASMIK Ace are credited with production. Yasuyuki Mutō ( Tokyo Revengers ) wrote the script. Keisuke Kojima was the character designer and chief animation director, and Keikankun Yamaguchi was the art director. Producers include Yūsuke Terada , Yūki Katayama , and Akane Taketsugu . Hiroaki Tsutsumi composed the music for the film.

The band Official HiGE DANdism performed the film's theme song "Rashisa."

A preview of the film screened at Annecy International Film Festival in June 2024 as part of the festival's Work in Progress lineup. The festival described the story:

Togashi is born to run. As a kid, he is naturally gifted and wins every 100-meter race without effort. But in sixth grade, he meets Komiya, a transfer student who is full of determination but lacks technique. In teaching him, Togashi gives Komiya a new purpose: to win no matter what. Years pass by, Togashi and Komiya meet again as rivals on the track and reveal their true selves.

Uoto ( Orb: On the Movements of the Earth ) launched the Hyakuemu manga in Kodansha 's Magazine Pocket app in November 2018 as Uoto 's first series, and Kodansha published the manga's fifth compiled book volume in October 2019.
author: ANN

title: Reincarnated as a Sword Season 2 Creditless Opening Featuring FZMZ's "DREAM OF BUTTERFLY" Released
content:
Reincarnated as a Sword Season 2 has released its creditless opening sequence featuring FZMZ’s “DREAM OF BUTTERFLY.” The song was written and composed by MAQUMA and JACK, with arrangement by HONNWAKA88. It was released digitally on October 7. HIDIVE previously confirmed that it would exclusively stream the anime as part of its Fall 2026 lineup.

Studio C2C is returning to animate Season 2, with Shinji Ishihira as director, Takahiro Nagano handling the series composition, and Atsuki Saito as the character designer.

You can also watch the ending video below.

The full confirmed staff and voice cast list includes:

• Ai Kakuma as Fran

• Shinichiro Miki as Teacher

• Goto Hiroki as Jet

• Yuma Uchida as Jean du Vix

• Shiori Izawa as Nameless

• Show Hayami as Lich

• Director: Shinji Ishihara

• Story Editor & Scripts: Takahiro Nagano

• Character Designs: Atsuko Saito

• Assistant Director: Kazunobu Shimizu

• Teacher Design: Shinya Asanuma

• Monster Design / Modeling: Chie Sakurai (Hinokuni Animation), Junpei Mukai, Shota Yano

• Action Director: Rino Isago, Satoshi Sakai, Shunya Nitta

• Color Design: Masato Takagi, Takeshi Kurihara

• Art Direction & Design: Masahiro Sato

• Art Boards: Kouki Nagayoshi

• Prop Design: Tomoki Yokoyama, Emi Kono

• Director of Photography: Masaaki Onodera

• 3DCG: Hinokuni Animation

• 2D & Monitor Graphics: Junpei Mukai

• Editing: Go Sadamatsu

• Sound Director: Shoji Hata

• Music: Yasuharu Takanashi (Team-MAX)

• Animation Production: C2C

• Opening Theme: FZMZ (“DREAM OF BUTTERFLY”)

• Ending Theme: Hanabie (“Baribari Buddy”)

Also check out the key visual below.

Yu Tanaka writes the original Reincarnated as a Sword light novel. The novel started off on the Shosetsuka ni Naro website in October 2015 with illustrations by LLO. GC Novels started publishing it in the light novel format in 2016. A manga adaptation by Tomowo Maruyama is ongoing as well, and there is also a spin-off manga Reincarnated as a Sword: Another Wish by Hinako Inoue, which began in June 2020. Seven Seas Entertainment licensed the light novel , the manga , and the spin-off manga and they describe the story:

When a 30-year-old salaryman and games enthusiast is suddenly killed in a car accident, he finds himself reborn into a fantasy world…but in the form of a sword! Now he’s in search of a beautiful woman to wield him, and a catgirl named Fran might be the exact adventuring partner he needs.
author: Anime Corner

title: Demon Slayer: Infinity Castle Reaches Impressive Streaming Milestone Ahead of Part 2
content:
Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Infinity Castle has been taking over the small screen one year after its big screen debut, and it’s hit an impressive new streaming milestone across multiple platforms as fans watch the film in anticipation of its big sequel. Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Infinity Castle first hit theaters across the world last year, and it ended up being one of the most successful anime film releases in cinematic history. So it’s no surprise to find out that its streaming launch has been met with the same success.

Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Infinity Castle hit Crunchyroll earlier this Summer for its streaming debut, but as of last month expanded that release to other platforms like Netflix, Hulu and Prime Video . Naturally the film has been doing well on each platform as not only has it netted some of the highest number of ratings on Crunchyroll, but has also dominated Netflix’s top movie spot in just the few weeks since its original streaming launch. It’s been a big deal.

Demon Slayer: Infinity Castle Dominates Streaming After Launch

As of the time of this writing, Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Infinity Castle is currently reviewed by over 100,000 users on Crunchyroll and that’s something that has not been done by many other feature film releases on the platform. Further demonstrating that popularity is the fact that it has also taken the top spot on the T op 10 Non-English Movies list on Netflix for the week of its release with over six million views as of this time. It’s been taken over the small screen much like the big screen debut, and that’s only going to continue from here on out.

Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Infinity Castle I doing so well upon its streaming release has been even more impressive when you consider that the film first hit theaters a year ago. Fans had been waiting this long for its official digital release, and have welcomed it with open arms as there was still a great deal of hype around it for those who want to watch it again. And with tons of new fans likely joining the fun, it’s easier for those fans to jump into the new film ahead of its big sequel release.

When Does Demon Slayer: Infinity Castle Part 2 Come Out?

Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Infinity Castle II has been officially confirmed to be in the works as the next film in the trilogy taking on the massive Infinity Castle arc from Koyoharu Gotoge’s original manga series. But unfortunately for those fans waiting for the release of the sequel, it’s yet to be revealed when fans will be able to check out the sequel in action. No release date or window has been confirmed for the sequel as of this time , nor have there been any reveals about its production staff, potential returning voice cast and more.

There could be a big update on the sequel revealed soon enough, however. Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba has been announced as one of the major titles that Shueisha will be showcasing during their upcoming Jump Festa 2027 event later this December , and that would be the perfect opportunity to share an update that fans have been waiting for. But for now, have you been streaming the new Demon Slayer movie? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: Overlord [Shin] Sekai-hen Manga Goes on Hiatus Due to Artist Matsuki's Hospitalization
content:
Matsuki debuted the manga in Kadokawa 's Comp Ace magazine in April 2024. Kadokawa published the manga's fourth compiled book volume on March 26.

The manga's story continues from the story of Hugin Miyama and Satoshi Ōshio 's Overlord manga adaptation (in the middle of the 10th volume's story), where Ainz won the battle on the Katze Plains and has founded a magical country.

Miyama and Ōshio launched the manga adaptation of Kugane Maruyama 's Overlord light novel series in Comp Ace magazine in 2014. The manga's first part ended in May 2023. Kadokawa published the manga's 19th volume on December 2023. Yen Press is publishing the manga in English, and released the 19th volume in October 2024.

Maruyama began the original light novel series online in 2010, and Kadokawa 's Enterbrain imprint began publishing the series in print with illustrations by so-bin in 2012. Kadokawa published the light novel series' 16th volume in July 2022. Yen Press is also releasing the novel series in North America. The novels are slated to end in their 18th volume.

Overlord IV , the fourth television anime season, premiered in July 2022. Crunchyroll streamed the anime as it aired in Japan. It is also streaming an English dub .

The anime's new film project titled Overlord: The Sacred Kingdom ( Gekijō-ban Overlord Sei Ōkoku-hen ) opened in Japan in September 2024. Crunchyroll screened the film in North America in November 2024, and also screened the film in Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and Latin America.

title: Marvel Tōkon: Fighting Souls Game's Trailer Reveals November 2 Release for Phoenix Cyclops DLC
content:
The official YouTube channel for PlayStation Studios , Arc System Works , and Marvel Games' Marvel Tōkon: Fighting Souls 4v4 tag team fighter game began streaming a gameplay trailer on Wednesday, and it reveals that the game will add Phoenix Cyclops as the first DLC character included in the "Year 1 Character & Stage Pass" on November 2:

Ray Chase , who plays Cyclops in the X-Men '97 animated series, voices Phoenix Cyclops.

The game launched for PlayStation 5 and PC via Steam and the Epic Games Store on August 6 (August 7 in Japan).

The game's Ultimate Edition includes pre-order bonuses, five character costumes, animated chromatic colors unlocked for all 20 launch characters, and the Year One pass that includes four characters and one stage.

Launch characters include: Ms. Marvel, Spider-Man, Peni Parker, Star-Lord, Storm, Wolverine, Magik, Danger, Doctor Doom, Captain America, Iron Man, Hulk, Black Panther, Magneto, Goblin, Carnage, Ghost Rider, Blade, Loki, and Deadpool.

The game has an Episode Mode single-player game mode, which presents a story in a motion comic format. The developers stated "a renowned writer from the original Marvel Comics " helped build the world and write the story of Episode Mode.

Daisuke Suzuki directed the opening movie at animation studio SANZIGEN . Keiko Terada ( SHOW-YA ) and mayu ( NEMOPHILA ) perform the original theme song "Stronger as One." Kanata Okajima wrote the lyrics. MEG (MEGMETAL) composed and arranged the song.
author: ANN

title: Love Through a Prism Anime Gets Novel Adaptation
content:
The official X/Twitter account for Shueisha 's Jump J-Books novel imprint announced on Wednesday that the Love Through a Prism ( Prism Rondo ) original anime series from Boys Over Flowers creator Yōko Kamio is getting a two-volume novel adaptation. Both volumes will ship on December 4 and will feature newly drawn cover art.

The series debuted on Netflix on January 15.

Kamio is responsible for the original story and original character designs. She also wrote the scripts with Saki Fujii . Kazuto Nakazawa ( Vassalord , B: The Beginning ) directed the series at Wit Studio . Yasuko Takahashi ( B: The Beginning , Fena: Pirate Princess ) served as one of the chief animation directors and character designer. Naoki Chiba (" naotyu- ") composed the music for the series.

The anime inspired a manga adaptation by Maki Minami ( Special A , Voice Over!: Seiyuu Academy ) that launched on Shueisha 's Shonen Jump+ service and on the Manga Mee girls manga app on January 8.

Guinness World Records awarded Kamio's Boys Over Flowers ( Hana Yori Dango ) manga as having the most published copies of a shōjo manga series written by a single author in 2023.

The manga was adapted into a Japanese anime, a 1995 Japanese live-action film, and a more well-known 2005 Japanese television drama, the latter of which spawned a sequel and a hit film . Taiwan also remade the manga into a live-action university drama titled Meteor Garden . Crunchyroll streamed a Korean live-action adaptation in 2011. A Filipino adaptation was announced in November 2017, but was never released. Hunan Television produced a Chinese live-action series adaptation in 2018. Thai television production company GMMTV produced a new live-action series that premiered in 2021.

The manga also inspired a stage musical adaptation ran in Japan from January to February 2016. The all-female Takarazuka Revue adapted the manga into a musical that ran in 2019. A new stage musical from Takarazuka Revue will ran from June 9-30.

title: Major Shonen Jump Series Returns for Anime Revival After Cancellation – Watch Opening
content:
One major Shonen Jump series has made its return with a new anime revival one year after its cancellation, and the opening theme for the anime is showing it all off. Shonen Jump has been going through a number of changes in the last few years as a good deal of long running franchises have reached their natural ends, and a number of others have been cancelled shortly into their runs . As Shueisha is now working through trying to find their next big hit, it’s meant that some franchises don’t get their fair shake.

That’s the case for Shun Numa’s Super Psychic Policeman Chojo , which was cancelled with Shonen Jump last Summer after only a year of serialization with the magazine. That made its announcement of an official anime adaptation all the more intriguing, and now that series has made its debut this month as part of the new wave of anime hitting for the Fall 2026 anime schedule . Check out the opening theme sequence for the Super Psychic Policeman Chojo anime below.

What to Know for Super Psychic Policeman Chojo Anime

Super Psychic Policeman Chojo has made its official debut as part of the Fall 2026 anime schedule, and the first episode of the new series is now available for streaming with Crunchyroll for fans outside of Japan. The opening theme for the new series is titled “That’s! Chojo” as performed by M!LK, and the new ending theme is titled “Mata Ashita,” as performed by Shifuku Poncho. As the franchise kicks off its return this October, fans are about to see much more of the cancelled series through its animated for.

As for the production team bringing it all to life , Super Psychic Policeman Chojo is directed by Junichi Yamamoto for Arvo Animation with Hayashi Mori writing the scripts, and Masakatsu Sasaki providing the character designs. The voice cast for the anime includes the likes of Yusuke Kobayashi as Meguru Chojo, Riko Aono as Nao Ippongi, Maria Naganawa as Robo-kun, Daisuke Ono as Yuki Inukai, Toshiya Miyata as Hajime Keinain, Nobuaki Kanemitsu as Hossan, Kanna Nakamura as Lily Togari, and Kazuki Ura as Heisuke Ban.

What’s Next for This Cancelled Shonen Jump Series?

Super Psychic Policeman Chojo is not the only cancelled Shonen Jump franchise to be making its official anime adaptation debut this year, nor is it the only one to make its debut this month. But what’s interesting about this revival is that it comes just a year after the cancellation of the original series rather than a longer stretch of time as seen with Psyren or Black Torch . It’s also a much different series than seen with the others, and likely has a much better chance of extending itself further after it adapts the rest of the manga release.

There might be only 65 total chapters of Super Psychic Policeman Chojo for the anime to cover, but it’s more of a comedy action series that could essentially continue with new original anime releases after its done adapting the material. Series creator Shun Numa has already moved onto new works within Shonen Jump that’s releasing new chapters in the current issues of the magazine , so we’ll have to see how it all works out from here.

How are you liking Super Psychic Policeman Chojo so far? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

The voice cast for the anime includes the likes of Yusuke Kobayashi as Meguru Chojo, Riko Aono as Nao Ippongi, Maria Naganawa as Robo-kun, Daisuke Ono as Yuki Inukai, Toshiya Miyata as Hajime Keinain, Nobuaki Kanemitsu as Hossan, Kanna Nakamura as Lily Togari, and Kazuki Ura as Heisuke Ban.
What’s Next for This Cancelled Shonen Jump Series?

Super Psychic Policeman Chojo is not the only cancelled Shonen Jump franchise to be making its official anime adaptation debut this year, nor is it the only one to make its debut this month. But what’s interesting about this revival is that it comes just a year after the cancellation of the original series rather than a longer stretch of time as seen with Psyren or Black Torch . It’s also a much different series than seen with the others, and likely has a much better chance of extending itself further after it adapts the rest of the manga release.

There might be only 65 total chapters of Super Psychic Policeman Chojo for the anime to cover, but it’s more of a comedy action series that could essentially continue with new original anime releases after its done adapting the material. Series creator Shun Numa has already moved onto new works within Shonen Jump that’s releasing new chapters in the current issues of the magazine , so we’ll have to see how it all works out from here.
How are you liking Super Psychic Policeman Chojo so far? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: The Best Godzilla Movie Might Be Getting a Sequel 10 Years Later, And the New Rumors Are Surprising
content:
The argument over the “best Godzilla movie” is one that fans have been waging about the king of the monsters for decades now. Though plenty of purists still believe that Ishirō Honda’s original film is the top of the pack, and there are plenty of reasons to side with them, there have been countless Godzilla movies in the seventy years since that film arrived, all with varying styles, ideas, and themes at their core. 2023’s Godzilla Minus One is certainly in contention for the conversation as well, especially being the only Oscar winner in the entire franchise, but ten years ago the series delivered a standalone reboot that has stood the test of time…and may finally get a follow-up.

Ever since Hideaki Anno and Shinji Higuchi’s Shin Godzilla arrived in 2016, distinct takes on the monster have been the mainstay of Toho’s plans for the character rather than universe expansion. Shin Godzilla would not only cement the titular monster in a new light, but also arrived to critical acclaim, winning the Japan Academy Film Prize for Picture of the Year (a feat Minus One repeated). Talk of a Shin Godzilla sequel has popped up some over the years, but a new rumor hints that production could begin as soon as next month.

Shin Godzilla 2 Rumors Point to November Start

News of the “secret” sequel to Shin Godzilla comes via SmartFlash , and it’s worth reiterating that this remains fully unverified. They report that filming on the movie may very well begin in November, with original Shin Godzilla stars Hiroki Hasegawa, Satomi Ishihara, and Yutaka Takenouchi set to reprise their roles. Furthermore, Tasuku Emoto of Shin Kamen Rider may appear in a new role, with Godzilla Minus One and Godzilla Minus Zero star Minami Hamabe potentially starring as well. One assumes that Hamabe will be playing a character unrelated to the Minus One version of the character, if in fact she appears in the film (which may not even be real) at all.

Though all of this news remains unconfirmed and there’s been no comment at all about it from Toho themselves, it’s easy to see why fans might think there’s a kernel of truth to this. Just last year came word from Bloomberg that Toho was developing a “potential sequel” to Shin Godzilla , but the studio made no announcement of it at the time and hasn’t commented since. To that end, Toho remaining tight-lipped about the potential for a new Shin Godzilla movie while they’re actively promoting Godzilla Minus Zero is par for the course with franchises of this nature. The upcoming movie is expected to not only be a box office success but a major critical favorite as well, with reviews from the film’s premiere currently holding at 97% on Rotten Tomatoes.

All that said, fans who have seen Shin Godzilla know that a sequel movie’s potential storyline was teased by the ending of the original movie. Though the kaiju was successfully frozen solid, two threats lingered: the first being that if Godzilla ever thawed out that a nuclear strike would be dropped on him, and the second being the small creatures forming at the base of his tail, perhaps hinting at smaller Godzilla-like creatures being the next evolution of the monster.

Once again, no official confirmation of a Shin Godzilla 2 has been revealed by Toho in any major way, but rumors are swirling about it, and the potential story was already set up a decade ago. What do you think? Do you want to see a sequel to Shin Godzilla , or should the movie stay standalone? Sound off in the comments below.

title: MediaOCD Announces Deal to Sell Select Aniplex of America Anime on Blu-ray Disc
content:
MediaOCD announced on Wednesday a sales agreement with Aniplex of America to sell select anime on Blu-ray Disc on the MediaOCD online store. Initial Aniplex of America titles available on MediaOCD 's website are the Gurren Lagann television series and films, and the two seasons of the Mashle: Magic and Muscles anime.

The Gurren Lagann Complete Blu-ray Disc Box includes the television series' 27 episodes and the Gurren Lagann the Movie -Childhood's End- , and Gurren Lagann the Movie -The Lights in the Sky Are Stars- films. The box set also includes the special Blu-ray Disc version of the anime's sixth episode "There Are Some Things I Just Have to See!!" and the broadcast version "Sit In the Hot Tub 'Til You're Sick!"

The Gurren Lagann the Movie 4K Ultra HD Blu-ray Disc features the two films remastered in 4K to celebrate the films' 15th anniversary in 2023. The release includes the English dub of both films, which debuted during the films' revival screenings in North America in 2024.

The 27-episode Gurren Lagann television anime series aired in 2007, and it spawned two anime films, two OVAs, several manga adaptations and spinoffs, and three stage plays.

Gurren Lagann the Movie –Childhood's End-– originally opened in September 2008, and Gurren Lagann the Movie – The Lights in the Sky Are Stars– opened in April 2009.

The Mashle: Magic and Muscles Season 1 Complete Blu-ray Disc Box and the Mashle: Magic and Muscles The Divine Visionary Candidate Exam Arc Complete Blu-ray Disc Box both include the following bonus content and materials: mini-character stickers, special booklet, original soundtrack CD, and creditless opening and ending videos. The season 1 box also includes a U.S. Blu-ray exclusive coaster.

The anime's first season debuted in April 2023, followed by the second season January 2024. The anime's third season will debut in January 2027.

title: Naruto Readies for Big Anime Reveal With New Teaser – Watch
content:
Naruto has been gearing up for a major return from the anime franchise, and it’s setting up for a big reveal later this weekend with the stars of the series in tow. Masashi Kishimoto’s Naruto franchise is now in the midst of a massive comeback as not only is there a new live-action feature film adaptation in the works , but there’s also plans to bring the anime back with a new project. And we’ll be seeing the first full look at the new release soon enough with a big reveal planned.

Naruto took fans by surprise earlier this Summer when it was first announced that the franchise was going to be bringing something big to New York Comic Con 2026 this month. The hype for the new anime really took off, however, when it was then announced that the franchise would be sharing the first real look at the anime’s future. Now the voice stars behind it have shared a special new teaser video hyping up their upcoming appearance at the event this coming weekend. You can check it out below.

Naruto Stars Hype Anime’s NYCC 2026 Reveals

Taking place on Saturday, October 10th at 5PM ET, “NARUTO: What’s Next?” is a special new panel for the franchise where they will reveal the first look at the future of the series. Viz Media confirmed that Studio Pierrot executive producer Tominaga Yoshihiko, Naruto Uzumaki voice star Junko Takeuchi, and Sasuke Uchiha voice star Noriaki Sugiyama will be in attendance. Not only that, but the franchise is going all out for the event with a special worldwide livestream planned so that even fans who won’t be physically attending the events can see the new reveals as they hit.

As for what this reveal will be, it’s going to be the first real look at the Naruto anime revival that has been on an indefinite hiatus for the last three years. First announced to be in the works following the 20th anniversary of the Naruto franchise, this new revival was touted to be a four episode miniseries featuring the earliest days of Team 7 from the original Naruto anime incarnation. First announced to be in development for a release in 2023 before it was put on an indefinite hiatus , it’s finally time to see what kind of shape it’s taken thus far.

What’s Next for Naruto?

It was also teased during this event that Naruto would be revealing a new animated film, but it’s yet to be known whether or not the film and revival are referring to the same project . There could be something else revealed for the anime entirely during this upcoming event, and that makes it all the more interesting for the New York Comic Con 2026 panel. Not only that, but there could be any sorts of other announcements that have even yet to be teased about the future of the franchise.

Naruto has been dormant for the past three years following Boruto: Naruto Next Generations also going on hiatus with its own anime release , so any forward momentum for the anime will be very much appreciated at this time. What are you hoping to see from Naruto ‘s anime revealed during New York Comic Con 2026? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!
